                            ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse, and

Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 5-G in the area

bounded by

         a line 224 feet south of and parallel to West Annitage Avenue;
         North Halsted Street; a line 274 feet south of and parallel to
         West Annitage Avenue; and the alley next west of and parallel to
         Noith Halsted Street,

to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District and a coiresponding uses district is

hereby established in the area above described.



SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.
